title: Rut depth in asphalt test sections (backward elimination)
intro: Twenty asphalt test sections were cored after one summer. The rut depth (mm) is to be explained by four candidate predictors: air voids in the mix (%), binder content (%), the highest pavement temperature (°C) and the truck traffic (thousands of equivalent single-axle loads, ESALs). Backward elimination starts with all four and removes the predictor with the largest p-value while that p-value is 0.05 or more. Read the Selection line to see what it did, then the final model.

settings.Name: Rut depth
settings.Predictors: Air voids, Binder, Pavement temp, Traffic
